base:
Use case: identity-preserve. EDIT the reference Ron sprite into a correct animation walk cycle. Reference is exact model: preserve identical adult face, black hair, head dimensions, green festive jacket, ivory shirt, purple pants, black boots, ribbon staff and pixel shading. Keep head and torso shapes rigid with at most tiny vertical bob. NOT eight similar poses: actual sequential alternating anatomical legs required.
Create EIGHT sprites in FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows, reading left-to-right top row then bottom row. Flat solid pure cyan RGB(0,255,255) background for game import, no labels, shadows, grid lines, ground or text. Whole character including staff and ribbons within each cell, same scale, feet baseline, camera and direction. One complete looping gait at 10fps.
Frame1 CONTACT A: near leg forward, far leg back, both feet down; free arm opposite leg.
Frame2 DOWN A: near foot supports weight, near knee bends, far heel lifts behind; stance contracts.
Frame3 PASSING A: near leg straight under hip supporting body; far knee bent and far boot airborne passing immediately beside planted near boot. FEET CLOSE, not extended stride.
Frame4 UP A: near support heel rises behind, far thigh advances and far knee lifted slightly ahead, far boot still airborne. Narrow stance.
Frame5 CONTACT B: FAR leg now forward, NEAR leg back, both feet down. Exact opposite leg arrangement from frame1.
Frame6 DOWN B: FAR supporting knee bends, NEAR heel lifts behind; stance contracts.
Frame7 PASSING B: FAR leg straight supports under hip; NEAR bent knee and airborne boot pass beside planted FAR foot. FEET CLOSE.
Frame8 UP B: FAR heel rises behind, NEAR thigh advances and near knee slightly forward, NEAR foot airborne ready to land in frame1. Narrow stance.
Leg ordering must be anatomically consistent: near leg always draws in front of far leg where overlapping. Never swap clothing/boots between legs. All poses must read WALKING not running, skipping or dancing. Staff held in SAME hand with stable grip; free arm subtly counter-swings; ribbons follow through slightly. Contact1 and contact5 must be visually distinct OPPOSITE legs. Passing3 and passing7 must have boots close together beneath hips and one clearly raised. Knee, thigh and foot movements gradual between frames including 8 to1.

contactB: Edit the attached exact Ron character sprite into ONE walking contact pose facing screen RIGHT. Preserve his exact head, face, hair, jacket, shirt, sash, staff hand, pixel-art style and proportions. Change legs and free arm only. CRITICAL leg pose: the VISIBLE FOREGROUND THIGH slopes diagonally BACKWARD toward screen LEFT from hip; its foreground boot is at BACK LEFT. The BACKGROUND thigh slopes diagonally FORWARD screen RIGHT and its boot is at FRONT RIGHT. Foreground thigh occludes background thigh at the crotch. Both boots rest on same groundline, a modest natural walking stride. Near knee is BACK LEFT, far knee FRONT RIGHT. No raised knee, no marching, no lunging. Staff stays in same hand. One complete character centered on solid pure cyan background, no ground/shadow/text. Keep head size and body scale from reference; do not redesign.
phases678:
Use case: identity-preserve. Reference is Ron at walk CONTACT B facing RIGHT: foreground near leg back-left and background far leg front-right. Preserve exactly that model, head, torso, clothes and staff. Create THREE frames in one horizontal row on flat pure cyan background, NO text or lines. These immediately FOLLOW the reference and are frames6,7,8 of the cycle. Keep whole character equal scale and complete.
LEFT frame6 DOWN B: far/background RIGHT boot remains planted forward and takes weight, far knee bends slightly; foreground near LEFT boot lifts behind, near knee flexes, not extending forward yet.
MIDDLE frame7 PASSING B: far/background boot supports directly UNDER HIP; foreground near thigh advances in FRONT OF far thigh, near knee bent modestly, near boot airborne immediately beside the planted boot. Boots close, raised boot sole only 8 percent of leg length off ground. Near leg MUST overlap in front of FAR planted leg.
RIGHT frame8 UP B: far support boot now slightly behind hip with heel raised; foreground near leg swings forward RIGHT but knee remains LOW, near thigh tilted forward about20 degrees from vertical, near shin extends toward next heel strike, boot slightly above floor ahead. No horizontal thigh or high marching knee.
Free arm moves gently opposite near leg. Torso same pixel proportions, small 1-2pixel bob only. Follow reference exact east profile, no perspective change. Do not repeat contact pose three times. Do not switch leg identity. No shadows or labels.
phase8: Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix ONLY the foreground swinging leg in this Ron walking sprite: bring its forward boot 25 percent closer to the hip horizontally, bend its knee slightly more, and keep heel just a little above ground, toes slightly raised ready for heel contact. This is late swing before a SMALL normal walking step, not a kick or march. Preserve foreground leg as foreground, purple pant shading, boot design, entire upper body, face, hair, staff, hand, ribbons, back supporting leg and proportions. One complete figure on same pure cyan background, no text or shadows. No head redraw or enlargement. Boot should be only moderately ahead of hip, not far outstretched.
phase4: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this exact Ron sprite to the instant BEFORE this contact pose, a low late-swing WALK pose facing RIGHT. Preserve head, face, hair, jacket, shirt, staff grip, free hand, waist and body proportions. Foreground NEAR leg remains back-left and is the supporting leg: front of its boot/toes touches floor while heel is raised slightly. Background FAR leg is reaching forward-right ready to land: far knee has only slight bend, far heel is just above floor and modestly ahead of hip, toes up a little. Far thigh and boot stay BEHIND the near thigh in overlap. Not a kick: keep stride shorter than reference, far boot about20percent closer horizontally to hip than in reference. No high knee, no horizontal thigh. Keep reference upper body exactly same. Single whole character centered on flat pure cyan background, no text/grid/shadow.
style458: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input1 contains THREE Ron sprites whose walking poses are CORRECT. Input2 is the correct rendering/model reference for the same character. Edit all THREE figures in input1 to match input2's material/volume details ONLY: restore full BAGGY PLUM PURPLE trousers with slightly broader thighs and knees, same yellow-red stitch/dash texture (not skinny reddish trousers). Match input2's long thin staff, exact small bottom cap shape and hanging ribbon silhouette/mass. Keep input1's precise leg positions, boot positions, hip-to-knee angles and foreground/background thigh overlap UNCHANGED. In left+middle sprites near thigh is backward LEFT, far thigh forward RIGHT; rightmost sprite near thigh forward RIGHT. This must remain exact. Keep head angle and face identity, torso proportions, staff hand fixed. Three complete sprites in ONE horizontal row, solid pure cyan background, no text, no labels, no ground shadow. Do not copy input2's leg pose. Do not turn these into identical poses. Only match clothing bulk/palette and staff/ribbon design to input2.
